title: Goa State champion
text: Wins the state title as a young player. Age, event and venue to be added.

title: Triple gold, Indian Masters Nationals, Jaipur
text: Three titles at one Nationals, described by the Goa Badminton Association as historic.

title: Bronze, BWF World Senior Championships, Huelva
text: Women's doubles 35+ with Sangeeta Mari; quarter-finalist in singles. One of India's five medals at the event.

title: Double gold, 47th Indian Masters Nationals, Mapusa
text: Women's singles 40+ and women's doubles 40+. Seeded at the BWF World Senior Championships the same year.

title: Double gold, 48th Indian Masters Nationals, Navelim
text: Retains both 40+ titles in front of a home crowd.
